conventions.pose: Camera.getPose(): physical camera pose, ARCore GL camera (+X right, +Y up, -Z forward), world +Y up; stored raw
conventions.tNs: Frame.getTimestamp() ns; time base not defined by ARCore
conventions.sysElapsedNs: SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos() when the GL thread received the frame
conventions.depth: Frame.acquireDepthImage16Bits(): uint16 mm, 0 = invalid, saved as 16-bit grayscale PNG; only new depth timestamps saved
conventions.depthConf: Frame.acquireRawDepthConfidenceImage(): uint8 0-255, 8-bit PNG, same frame as rawDepth
conventions.rgb: Frame.acquireCameraImage() YUV_420_888 -> JPEG, sensor orientation (not rotated)
conventions.depth.intrinsics: textureIntrinsics scaled by depth size / texture size (F4)
